correctness.rationale: Full-branch measure preservation follows by summing the 2 geometric inverse weights; Bernoulli cylinder weights multiply. For graph tubes, a tail strip of width <=epsilon bounds uncountably many accumulated pieces while 2N nearly vertical segments contribute at most 4epsilon N + O(epsilon); horizontal cross sections of these separated graph pieces give at least 4epsilon N - O(epsilon). Both N agree with log(1/epsilon)/log(1/q) up to O_q(1). Countable unit segments have dimension 1 and infinite H1. A 1276-case rational checker and six scale probes were run; the proof, not these samples, establishes the infinite theorem.
